classical
haveI : Fintype (blowupC5 n).edgeSet := SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSet (blowupC5 n)
haveI : Fintype H.edgeSet := SimpleGraph.fintypeEdgeSet H
obtain ⟨c⟩ := hBip
let D := (blowupC5 n).edgeFinset \ H.edgeFinset
have h_eg (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) : ∃ i : ZMod 5, Sym2.mk ((i, g i), (i + 1, g (i + 1))) ∈ D := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := zmod5_cycle_has_same (fun j => c (j, g j))
  use i
  rw [Finset.mem_sdiff, SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset, SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
    refine ⟨?_, Or.inl rfl⟩
    intro h_eq
    have h_i : i = i + 1 := congr_arg Prod.fst h_eq
    have h_one : (1 : ZMod 5) = 0 := by
      calc (1 : ZMod 5) = (i + 1) - i := by ring
      _ = i - i := by rw [← h_i]
      _ = 0 := by ring
    exact zmod5_one_ne_zero h_one
  · intro hH_adj
    exact c.valid hH_adj hi.symm
let i_g (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) : ZMod 5 := Classical.choose (h_eg g)
let eg_val (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n) := Sym2.mk ((i_g g, g (i_g g)), (i_g g + 1, g (i_g g + 1)))
have h_eg_mem (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) : eg_val g ∈ D := Classical.choose_spec (h_eg g)
have h_fiber (d : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n)) (hd : d ∈ D) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 5 → Fin n)).filter (fun g => eg_val g = d)).card ≤ n ^ 3 := by
  have hd_edge : d ∈ (blowupC5 n).edgeFinset := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hd |>.1
  obtain ⟨k, a, b, hd_eq⟩ := blowupC5_edge_exists n d hd_edge
  let inj_map (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) : Fin n × Fin n × Fin n := (g (k + 2), g (k + 3), g (k + 4))
  have h_inj : Set.InjOn inj_map ↑((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 5 → Fin n)).filter (fun g => eg_val g = d)) := by
    intro g1 hg1 g2 hg2 h_eq
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at hg1 hg2
    have hg1_eq : eg_val g1 = d := hg1.2
    have hg2_eq : eg_val g2 = d := hg2.2
    have h_cases (g : ZMod 5 → Fin n) (hg_eq : eg_val g = d) : g k = a ∧ g (k + 1) = b := by
      have hg_eq2 : Sym2.mk ((i_g g, g (i_g g)), (i_g g + 1, g (i_g g + 1))) = Sym2.mk ((k, a), (k + 1, b)) := by
        rw [← hd_eq]; exact hg_eq
      rw [Sym2.eq_iff] at hg_eq2
      rcases hg_eq2 with ⟨⟨hk1, hk2⟩, ⟨hk3, hk4⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨hk1, hk2⟩, ⟨hk3, hk4⟩⟩
      · subst hk1
        exact ⟨hk2, hk4⟩
      · exfalso
        have h_two : (2 : ZMod 5) = 0 := by
          calc (2 : ZMod 5) = (i_g g + 1 + 1) - i_g g := by ring
          _ = k - (k + 1) := by rw [hk3, hk1]
          _ = 0 := by ring
        exact zmod5_two_ne_zero h_two
    obtain ⟨hg1_k, hg1_k1⟩ := h_cases g1 hg1_eq
    obtain ⟨hg2_k, hg2_k1⟩ := h_cases g2 hg2_eq
    ext z
    have h_zk : z = k + (z - k) := by ring
    rw [h_zk]
    generalize h_diff : z - k = diff
    dsimp [inj_map] at h_eq
    rcases h_eq with ⟨h_eq2, h_eq3, h_eq4⟩
    fin_cases diff
    · rw [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, hg1_k, hg2_k]
    · rw [Nat.cast_one, hg1_k1, hg2_k1]
    · exact h_eq2
    · exact h_eq3
    · exact h_eq4
  have h_le := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn inj_map (by intro x _; exact Finset.mem_univ _) h_inj
  have h_prod : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n × Fin n)).card = n ^ 3 := by
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
    ring
  rwa [h_prod] at h_le
have h_sum := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := eg_val) (s := Finset.univ) (t := D) (fun g _ => h_eg_mem g)
have h_card_univ : (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 5 → Fin n)).card = n ^ 5 := by
  rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
  simp
rw [h_card_univ] at h_sum
have h_le_sum : ∑ d ∈ D, ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 5 → Fin n)).filter (fun g => eg_val g = d)).card ≤ ∑ d ∈ D, n ^ 3 :=
  Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d hd => h_fiber d hd)
rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul] at h_le_sum
have h_trans : n ^ 5 ≤ D.card * n ^ 3 := by linarith
have h_pos : 0 < n ^ 3 := Nat.pow_pos _hn
have h_mul : n ^ 5 = n ^ 2 * n ^ 3 := by ring
rw [h_mul] at h_trans
exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_trans h_pos

lemma zmod5_one_ne_zero : (1 : ZMod 5) ≠ 0 := by decide
lemma zmod5_two_ne_zero : (2 : ZMod 5) ≠ 0 := by decide

lemma zmod5_cycle_has_same (f : ZMod 5 → Fin 2) : ∃ i : ZMod 5, f (i + 1) = f i := by
  revert f
  decide

lemma blowupC5_edge_exists (n : ℕ) (d : Sym2 (ZMod 5 × Fin n))
    (hd : d ∈ (blowupC5 n).edgeFinset) :
    ∃ (k : ZMod 5) (a b : Fin n), d = Sym2.mk ((k, a), (k + 1, b)) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨u, v⟩, rfl⟩ := Quot.exists_rep d
  rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj] at hd
  have h_adj : u.1 + 1 = v.1 ∨ v.1 + 1 = u.1 := by
    rcases hd.2 with (h | h) | (h | h) <;> [exact Or.inl h; exact Or.inr h; exact Or.inr h; exact Or.inl h]
  rcases h_adj with h1 | h2
  · use u.1, u.2, v.2
    have h_v : (u.1 + 1, v.2) = v := Prod.ext h1 rfl
    rw [h_v, Prod.mk.eta]
  · use v.1, v.2, u.2
    have h_u : (v.1 + 1, u.2) = u := Prod.ext h2 rfl
    rw [h_u, Prod.mk.eta, Sym2.eq_swap]
    rfl
